name: Lyft Level 5 Motion Prediction Dataset
summary: 以 25 秒场景组织的交通参与者位置与运动轨迹，配有语义地图，用于运动预测、规划与仿真。
summaryEn: Traffic-agent positions and motions organized into 25-second scenes with semantic maps, for motion prediction, planning and simulation.
scale: 170,000 scenes / over 1,000 hours reported in the paper
scaleZh: 论文报告 170,000 个场景、超过 1,000 小时
access: Paper identifies a data channel; current access not tested
accessZh: 论文注明数据渠道；当前访问未实测
verdict: 以 25 秒场景组织的交通参与者位置与运动轨迹，配有语义地图，用于运动预测、规划与仿真。

evidence.statement: The cited motion-prediction release contains 25-second scenes with positions/motions of traffic participants and maps; distinguish it from Lyft perception-only releases.
